content:
name: Epic
about: Define a multi-feature product or engineering outcome.
title: "[Epic] "
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: "GitHub is a coordination projection. Link the canonical product/program artifact."
  - type: input
    id: identifier
    attributes:
      label: Epic identifier
      placeholder: EPIC-XXX
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: outcome
    attributes:
      label: Outcome
      description: State the measurable outcome, not a task list.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: source
    attributes:
      label: Canonical source
      placeholder: product/backlog/...
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: exit
    attributes:
      label: Exit evidence
      description: What evidence will prove the Epic outcome is achieved?
    validations:
      required: true
